{{Quote|I am Morrun Dokaas, lord of beasts. I am Revanite, and I am Sith.|Morrun Dokaas|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=bonus|The Pilgrim's Path|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>}}
'''Morrun Dokaas''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He was secretly a member of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]] in which he helped to test new members during their pilgrimage to join the cult. He did so by asking the recruit a number of questions about the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] use of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] as allies.
